actors.name: Kettlewell parish clerk
actors.private_context: The clerk posted notices about the open meeting regarding the bus-route cut. They are aware that the last such meeting drew 22 attendees. They hope for good turnout but have no control over who attends.

actors.name: Villagers of Kettlewell
actors.private_context: The villagers have seen the notices about the open meeting. Some may be concerned about the bus-route cut, but attendance is voluntary and depends on individual interest and availability. The previous meeting's attendance of 22 is known to some.

shared_context: An open meeting about the bus-route cut is scheduled in Kettlewell. The parish clerk has posted notices in public places. The meeting will take place at a local venue. Attendance is open to all villagers. The last such meeting drew 22 attendees.

starting_events.description: The parish clerk has posted notices about the open meeting regarding the bus-route cut.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least thirty distinct villagers attended the open meeting before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
